{{Top|leg}}
The '''Beltway''' was a modified corridor installed by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] technicians aboard the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' above [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. An octagonal shaft, it served as a literal ''spear'' hidden from view within ''Lusankya's'' hull. The shaft was filled with explosives and [[Operation Emperor's Spear|rammed]] into the hull of [[Domain Hul]]'s [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]].
